== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Shyrax the Third]] is the forty-one-year-old sovereign of the planet [[Karosha]], having ascended to the throne nine years ago following her mother's abdication. Although she was officially convicted of treason by the [[Dragon Court]], which resulted in her cousin [[Felrex]] assuming the role of [[King Regent]], she reportedly escaped her imprisonment. Now known as the Rebel [[Queen]], she has been actively recruiting loyal troops throughout [[Alliance space]] and managing a rebel fleet. [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] is a skilled combatant and technician who utilizes telekinesis, armor, and a glowing [[wand]] in battle. Beyond her royal status, she serves as the [[Commander]] of [[The Last Horizon]] and the Guardian of [[Shadow Ark]]. She represents a political alternative to the current [[Karoshan]] leadership and has been involved in military actions, such as an attack on the [[Dornoth system]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|She serves as an alternative to the rule of the [[King Regent]]. She acts as a leader for a force composed of [[Karoshan]] exiles.}}
